newsitem.title: USA: PRESS DIGEST - Wall Street Journal - Nov 19.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Wall Street Journal - Nov 19.

text.p: General Motors Corp plans to sell four plants in the United States and Canada, the Wall Street Journal reported.
- Tosco Corp will pay more than $1.4 billion for Unocal Corp's West Coast assets.
- Mattel Inc will buy Tyco Toys Inc for $755 million in stock.
- Deutsche Telekom AG's shares surged after its initial public offering.
- Lockheed Martin will close eight sites in the United States.
- Hewlett-Packard Co fell short of quarterly profit expectations.
- The Dow Jones industrial average broke its record streak to close lower at 6,346.91.
- The British pound reached a more than four-year high against the U.S. dollar.
- Kellogg Co will pay $455 million to acquire the Lender's bagel business from Philip Morris Cos Inc's Kraft unit.
- Venture capital firms expect a slowdown in the industry's boom.
- A federal appeals court reversed a $7.2 million jury award against a unit of AIG.
- Baxter International Inc and Allegiance Corp together won a seven-year health care supply pact.
- Investors have spent almost $104.5 billion on new stock from U.S. issuers so far this year.
- MasterCard said it acquired a 51-percent interest in British smart-card maker Mondex.
- U.S. bond prices ended lower in quiet trading as the market took a pause from its latest gains.
- Some industry analysts are wondering why Carl Icahn has chosen Thomas Rattigan as his candidate to run RJR Nabisco Holdings Corp.
